propositions: Base-query loop in _build_snapshot iterates all projects in a flat loop with no per-project error isolation; a single project's transport failure (4xx, 5xx, timeout, rate-limit) aborts the entire pass for all projects.

Extract _fetch_project helper symmetric to _enrich_project; drain both base queries (active + done-recent) for one project into a local dict and merge into snapshot only on success, ensuring no partial keys leak as deletions.

Wrap per-project base-query fetch in try/except: on transport error emit fetcher-project-fetch-failed alert (project + pass_id) and continue to next project; re-raise BackendPaginationStallError and SilentTruncationError unchanged.
Preserve fail-closed behavior for syntactically-invalid/absent project keys by calling _validate_project_key outside the per-project try block (626d unchanged).

Add always-on unit test with fake client where one project raises HTTPError and another returns issues; verify failed project does not abort pass, succeeded project's issues land in snapshot, and alert fires for failed project.
